children: WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. (MPWR) released a profit for its third quarter that Increases, from the same period last year
The company's bottom line totaled $271.067 million, or $5.51 per share.  This compares with $179.766 million, or $3.74 per share, last year.
Excluding items, Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. reported adjusted earnings of $402.7 million or $8.19 per share for the period.
The company's revenue for the period rose 63.1% to $1.202 billion from $737.176 million last year.
